text: At the same time, US data on what people pay showed coffee cost 6.1% more than in the same month a year earlier. You might wonder, Did prices fall or rise? But this data was for a different month than the bean price measure. It also does not show the price of coffee at a cafe. Don't put the 2 numbers in the ring just yet. So, how long does it take for bean prices to reach a price tag? People in the market and experts spoke with Reuters. They estimate raw-bean prices take at least about 9 months to appear in US shop prices. The road to a price tag is quite a long journey. The article says US companies that roast coffee keep raw beans in stock. Roasting and packing the beans also take time. These companies often talk with stores about prices on a regular basis. A shop's price tag does not change the moment the market moves.
